[PATH:literature] Review of firm-level case studies on automation investment decisions in quick-service restaurants following minimum wage hikes, including cost-benefit analyses and labor hour records. — Provides qualitative and quantitative evidence on the causal mechanism—whether wage increases accelerate automation adoption and reduce total hours before demand can adjust.
